speed.bracket_method: arithmetic mean of A1/A2 per-fixture median TPS
speed.context_aggregation: equal-weight geometric mean across per-fixture median TPS
speed.plain_scope: diagnostic controls, not statistically independent performance claims
speed.settings_scope: available token lengths, requested lengths, sampling and prompt identity across each fixture

trace_sources.indexing: zero-based eligible verification index per three collector context buckets

traffic.yield_semantics: Potential new emissions are 1 + accepted prefix per window, before stop/output budgets; the pending input was already emitted and is not counted again. First prefill output is outside this range. This is not observed committed output count.
traffic.bytes_per_yield_scope: Target forward + DSpark tap absorption only; excludes full MTP draft passes, argmax/readback and prefill. Profiled CPU wall times are diagnostics, not GPU time or unprofiled speed. Ratios are per Spark and must not be summed into its bandwidth.

semantics.sysmem_fill_GB: L2 sectors filled from system memory, counted at 32 bytes per sector
semantics.l2_sysmem_read_request_GB: L2 sysmem-aperture read request sectors; can include L2 hits
semantics.l2_sysmem_write_request_GB: L2 sysmem-aperture write request sectors; not DRAM writeback bytes
semantics.gpu_range_ms: GPU duration metric for the instrumented verification range
semantics.sysmem_fill_inferred_GBps: system-memory L2 fills divided by GPU range duration; not DRAM-total bandwidth

limitations: The three byte counters overlap in scope and must not be added together.
L2 request-sector counts are not total physical DRAM reads or writes.
Ranges are instrumented; use separate unprofiled requests for speed claims.
Do not add both ranks and divide by one rank bandwidth when forming a roofline.
Grouping by row width does not control the union of selected MoE experts.

weight_model.meaning: Analytical once-through active weight bytes for one plain token, not measured total traffic.
weight_model.tensor_parallelism: Each Spark holds half of every expert intermediate; all six selected experts run on both ranks.
weight_model.verification_model: fixed bytes + sum_over_layers(unique selected expert IDs * that layer expert-slice bytes)
